options.description: The room marks the study 'out of date: <what changed>' and the band offers to rewrite it at the same depth; you accept or ignore. Nothing is rewritten without you.
options.label: Mark it, offer a refresh (Recommended)

options.description: Plumb rewrites the study at the same depth in the background and shows what changed. Always current, but costs model calls you didn't ask for.
options.label: Rewrite automatically

options.description: The room marks it out of date; no refresh is offered. You ask for a new study if you want one.
options.label: Mark only
